channel.title: Somalia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Somalia, every source cited.

item.title: UN mission in Somalia closes after 30 years
item.description: The United Nations Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) ceased operations on Saturday, ending a long UN presence.

item.title: Uganda begins Somalia troop pullout after 20 years
item.description: The first contingent of 109 soldiers departed Mogadishu airport on Friday, marking the start of a withdrawal.

item.title: Fugitive rescues 40 Somali soldiers
item.description: Duqow, sentenced to death, provided food and guided stranded troops to safety in Lower Shabelle.
